name: Bomdila Town
description: District headquarters of West Kameng at about 2,415 m elevation. Scenic hill station with apple orchards, Buddhist gompas, craft centres and views of the Eastern Himalayas. Gateway on the Tezpur-Tawang highway.
facts: Known for apple orchards and monasteries

name: Seppa
description: District headquarters of East Kameng, situated on the banks of the Kameng River. Scenic valley town with riverside views, local Nyishi markets, and a base for exploring surrounding valleys and hill stations. Elevation about 363 m.
facts: Lies on the bank of Kameng River
Formerly known as Sepla meaning marshy land
Connected by road to Itanagar and Tezpur

name: Bameng Valley
description: Scenic valley and cool hill station about 48 km north of Seppa. Features agricultural fields, forests, traditional Nyishi villages, and panoramic mountain views. Peaceful countryside ideal for nature and culture.
facts: Offers views of surrounding hills and Gorichaan peaks
Cooler climate like a hill station

name: Chayangtajo
description: Hilltop town about 81 km north of Seppa overlooking the Himalayas. Famous for views of the snow-peaked Gorichaan (Gorichen) mountain. Known for Nyishi and Puroik culture, cardamom plantations, and adventure potential.
facts: Famous for Gorichaan snow peak views

name: Pappu Valley (Lumdung)
description: One of the three scenic valleys near Seppa, featuring meandering rivers, paddy fields on banks, and lush greenery. Lumdung area is known for migratory birds in winter. About 21 km from Seppa.
facts: Part of the Three Valleys of East Kameng
Famous for migratory birds in winter

name: Kameng River (Seppa section)
description: Major river flowing through East Kameng, popular for angling and fishing in winter (permission required). Offers scenic river views, potential for rafting in canyons, and is the lifeline of the district.
facts: Good spot for angling and fishing in winter

name: Khenewa Valley
description: Verdant valley with scenic river views, open spaces, and misty hills in winter. Ideal for landscape photography, peaceful walks, and exploring local marketplaces and Nyishi culture.
facts: Known for verdant hills and river views
Winter mist adds to the beauty

name: Lada
description: Remote mountain settlement surrounded by forests, steep hills, and babbling brooks. Offers peace, privacy, and opportunities for trekking and experiencing tribal traditions in pristine landscapes.

name: Gorichaan Viewpoint
description: Viewpoint areas near Chayangtajo and Bameng offering views of the snow-capped Gorichaan (Gorichen) peaks. Popular for photography of the majestic Himalayas, especially in clear mornings.
facts: Best in clear weather for Himalayan vistas
Gorichen is a major Eastern Himalayan massif
Local name for the sacred peaks
